decided: The configuration guide names the two new permissions and says that the archive permission also pushes the work, rewrites a per-change pull request's description or adds the change's entry to a program pull request, and marks only a per-change pull request ready for review, while merging stays the user's.
alternatives: name only the two permissions and leave the outward writes to the specification
leave the guide's sentence saying neither step can be granted until a later release
why: A user deciding whether to grant the archive step reads the guide, and the archive step's outward writes are exactly what they need to know before granting it.

defines.definition: a pull request opened for one change alone
one pull request that all the changes of an architecture doc share, each change adding its own entry to it
